description: A tall silver flagpole in the centre flies a red flag with yellow stars under a dark stormy sky. Below, a dense crowd of people in dark, drab 1940s-50s style clothing, many in fedora hats, faces away from the viewer in the foreground. Behind them is a traditional Chinese gate-tower with red lanterns and a portrait, and red banners with characters on the wall. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
reason: Painted Chinese characters are visible on the banners of the gate-tower wall (both sides of the portrait). The card must have no painted text; repaint without any legible characters or signage.
